name: Cauliflower Fried Rice with Tofu
steps: Pan-fry tofu cubes until golden; remove.
Scramble eggs; add carrot, garlic, ginger, cauliflower rice 5 minutes.
Add peas, tofu, tamari, sesame oil, green onion.

name: Vegetarian Chili-Stuffed Sweet Potatoes
steps: Boil whole sweet potatoes 20–25 minutes until tender (boiling keeps the GI far lower than baking).
Sauté onion, pepper, garlic, spices; add beans and tomatoes; simmer 15 minutes.
Split potatoes; fill with chili; top yogurt, cheddar, green onion.

name: Eggplant Rollatini (Ricotta & Spinach)
steps: Slice eggplant lengthwise thin; brush with oil; roast at 425°F 12 minutes until pliable.
Mix ricotta, egg, spinach, parmesan, garlic; spread on slices and roll.
Place in marinara; top mozzarella; bake at 375°F 25 minutes; basil.

name: White Bean & Kale Skillet with Poached Eggs
steps: Sauté garlic and pepper flakes in oil; add tomatoes and beans; simmer 5 minutes.
Add kale until wilted; make wells; crack eggs; cover 6 minutes.
Top parmesan and lemon.

name: Tempeh Bolognese over Chickpea Pasta
steps: Crumble tempeh; brown in oil with onion, carrot, celery, garlic.
Add wine, tomatoes, seasoning; simmer 20 minutes.
Serve over al dente pasta with parmesan.

name: Stuffed Cabbage Rolls with Lentils
steps: Blanch cabbage leaves. Mix lentils, cauliflower rice, sautéed onion, garlic, walnuts, paprika, salt.
Roll filling in leaves; place in a dish; cover with tomato sauce and tomatoes.
Bake covered at 350°F 60 minutes; dill.

name: Grilled Feta & Veggie Skewers
steps: Thread feta cubes and vegetables on skewers; brush with oil and oregano.
Grill 8–10 minutes, turning gently.
Serve over chickpeas dressed with lemon.

name: Cauliflower Steaks with Chimichurri & White Beans
steps: Cut cauliflower into 1-inch steaks; brush with a third of the oil; roast at 425°F 25 minutes, flipping once.
Blend remaining oil, herbs, garlic, vinegar, oregano, pepper flakes.
Serve steaks over warm beans with chimichurri.

name: Tofu Tikka Masala
steps: Toss tofu cubes with half the yogurt and spices; roast at 425°F 20 minutes.
Sauté onion, ginger, garlic, remaining spices; add tomatoes, simmer 10 minutes; add coconut milk and yogurt.
Add tofu; serve over cauliflower rice with cilantro.

name: Spinach Artichoke Stuffed Spaghetti Squash
steps: Roast halved squash 40 minutes; scrape strands.
Mix strands with sautéed spinach and garlic, artichokes, cream cheese, yogurt, beans, half the cheeses.
Return to shells; top remaining cheese; broil 4 minutes.

name: Moroccan Vegetable Tagine with Chickpeas
steps: Sauté onion, garlic, spices in oil.
Add vegetables, tomatoes, chickpeas, harissa; simmer covered 25 minutes.
Top cilantro and toasted almonds.

name: Egg White Veggie Frittata with Goat Cheese
steps: Sauté asparagus in oil in an ovenproof skillet 4 minutes; add spinach.
Pour in whisked egg whites and eggs with salt; add tomatoes, dot goat cheese.
Bake at 375°F 15 minutes; chives.

name: Peanut Tofu Lettuce Wraps
steps: Crumble tofu; pan-fry in oil 8 minutes until browned.
Whisk peanut butter, tamari, lime, sriracha, garlic, water; toss half with tofu.
Fill lettuce; add vegetables; drizzle remaining sauce; peanuts.

name: Greek Lentil Moussaka-Style Bake
steps: Roast eggplant slices with oil 20 minutes.
Simmer lentils with onion, garlic, tomatoes, cinnamon, oregano 10 minutes.
Layer; top yogurt whisked with eggs, parmesan, nutmeg; bake at 375°F 30 minutes.

name: Veggie Burger Bowls with Hummus
steps: Mash chickpeas with oats, egg, garlic, cumin, parsley, salt; form patties; pan-fry 5 minutes per side.
Bowl greens, cucumber, tomato, olives.
Add patties and hummus; lemon.

name: Tofu & Vegetable Skewers with Chimichurri
steps: Thread pressed tofu and vegetables; brush with a third of the oil; grill 10–12 minutes.
Blend remaining oil, herbs, garlic, vinegar, oregano, salt.
Spoon over skewers.

name: Cabbage & Mushroom Stir-Fry with Eggs
steps: Scramble eggs in oil; remove.
Stir-fry mushrooms until browned; add garlic, ginger, cabbage 5 minutes.
Return eggs; add tamari, vinegar, sesame oil, green onion, chili crisp.

name: Mediterranean Baked Feta with Chickpeas & Tomatoes
steps: Place feta in a dish surrounded by tomatoes, chickpeas, olives, garlic; drizzle oil, oregano, pepper flakes.
Bake at 400°F 25 minutes until tomatoes burst.
Stir in spinach and basil; mash feta into the sauce.

name: Edamame Fried Cauliflower Rice
steps: Scramble eggs; remove.
Stir-fry carrot, garlic, ginger, cauliflower rice 5 minutes; add edamame.
Return eggs; add tamari, sesame oil, green onion, torn nori.

name: Zucchini & Corn Fritters with Yogurt
steps: Grate zucchini; salt; squeeze dry; mix with corn, eggs, almond flour, parmesan, green onion.
Pan-fry spoonfuls in oil 3 minutes per side.
Serve with yogurt, lime, cilantro.

name: Portobello 'Steaks' with Cauliflower Mash
steps: Marinate caps in balsamic, tamari, garlic, half the oil; roast at 425°F 18 minutes.
Mash steamed cauliflower with butter, milk, parmesan, salt.
Serve mushrooms over mash with warm beans and thyme.

name: Thai Peanut Tempeh Bowls
steps: Pan-fry tempeh cubes in oil; steam broccoli.
Whisk peanut butter, tamari, lime, ginger, sriracha, water.
Bowl cauliflower rice, vegetables, tempeh; sauce; peanuts.

name: Caprese Zucchini Noodle Bowl with Chickpeas
steps: Warm zoodles with garlic in oil 2 minutes.
Toss with chickpeas, tomato, mozzarella.
Balsamic, basil, salt.

name: Black Bean Enchilada Casserole (Low-Carb Tortillas)
steps: Sauté onion, pepper, cumin; mix with beans, corn, chiles.
Layer tortillas, filling, sauce, cheese.
Bake at 375°F 25 minutes; yogurt, cilantro.

name: Miso Glazed Eggplant with Edamame
steps: Halve eggplants; score; brush with avocado oil; roast at 425°F 20 minutes.
Whisk miso, tamari, vinegar, sesame oil, ginger, sweetener; brush on; broil 3 minutes.
Serve with edamame, green onion, sesame.

name: Egg Roll Bowl with Tofu
steps: Crumble tofu; brown in oil 8 minutes.
Add garlic, ginger, slaw, tamari, vinegar; cook 5 minutes.
Sesame oil, green onion, sriracha.

name: Roasted Vegetable & Goat Cheese Frittata
steps: Roast vegetables with oil at 425°F 15 minutes.
Whisk eggs, milk, salt; pour over vegetables in an ovenproof skillet; dot goat cheese, thyme.
Bake at 375°F 18 minutes.

name: Chickpea 'Tuna' Salad Lettuce Wraps
steps: Mash chickpeas roughly.
Mix with celery, onion, pickle, mayo, yogurt, Dijon, lemon, crumbled nori, dill.
Serve in lettuce cups.

name: Loaded Cauliflower Casserole
steps: Steam cauliflower; chop.
Mix yogurt, cream cheese, eggs, garlic powder, half the cheddar, salt; fold in cauliflower.
Top cheddar; bake at 375°F 25 minutes; green onion.

name: Sesame Tofu Noodle Bowl (Shirataki)
steps: Pan-fry tofu until crisp.
Rinse and dry-fry shirataki; stir-fry vegetables 3 minutes.
Whisk tahini, tamari, vinegar, sesame oil, garlic, ginger, water; toss everything; sesame.

name: Chipotle Black Bean Lettuce Tacos
steps: Sauté onion, garlic, cumin; add beans, chipotle, splash of water; mash lightly; cook 6 minutes.
Fill romaine leaves.
Top avocado, pico, cotija, cilantro, lime.

name: Spinach Ricotta Stuffed Zucchini Boats
steps: Halve zucchini; scoop.
Mix ricotta, spinach, egg, parmesan, garlic, nutmeg, salt; fill.
Spoon marinara over; top mozzarella; bake at 400°F 25 minutes.

name: Lentil Sloppy Joes (Lettuce or Muffin)
steps: Sauté onion, pepper, garlic in oil.
Add lentils, sauce, paste, vinegar, Dijon, paprika, sweetener; simmer 10 minutes.
Serve on toasted muffin halves or lettuce.

name: Tofu Shakshuka
steps: Sauté onion, pepper, garlic, spices in oil.
Add tomatoes and harissa; simmer 10 minutes.
Nestle tofu slabs into the sauce; cover 8 minutes; parsley.

name: Broccoli Tofu Stir-Fry with Garlic Sauce
steps: Pan-fry tofu cubes until golden; remove.
Stir-fry broccoli, garlic, ginger; add broth, cover 2 minutes.
Add tamari, vinegar, arrowroot slurry, sesame oil, tofu, pepper flakes.

name: Greek Chickpea Stuffed Eggplant
steps: Score and roast eggplant halves with half the oil at 400°F 25 minutes; scoop flesh.
Sauté onion, garlic, flesh, tomato, chickpeas, oregano, cinnamon.
Refill shells; top feta; bake 15 minutes; parsley.

name: Cauliflower Mac & Cheese (Chickpea Pasta)
steps: Cook pasta al dente; steam cauliflower.
Blend half the cauliflower with milk, cream cheese, Dijon, garlic powder, nutritional yeast, salt; warm with cheddar.
Toss with pasta and remaining florets.

name: Tempeh 'Sausage' & Peppers
steps: Crumble tempeh; sauté in oil with seasoning, fennel, paprika, tamari until browned.
Add peppers, onion, garlic; cook 8 minutes; add marinara.
Simmer 5 minutes; parmesan.

name: Herbed Cottage Cheese Stuffed Peppers
steps: Halve peppers; roast 10 minutes.
Mix cottage cheese, eggs, spinach, parmesan, herbs, garlic, salt; fill.
Top tomato; bake at 375°F 20 minutes until set.

name: Cuban Black Beans with Cauliflower Rice
steps: Sauté onion, pepper, garlic, spices in oil.
Add beans, broth, bay; simmer 15 minutes; mash some; add vinegar.
Serve over cauliflower rice with avocado, cilantro.

name: Roasted Veggie Hummus Bowl
steps: Roast cauliflower, broccoli, pepper, onion, chickpeas with oil and za'atar at 425°F 22 minutes.
Spread hummus in bowls.
Top roasted vegetables, cucumber, tomato, lemon, parsley.

name: Deviled Eggs (Greek Yogurt)
steps: Hard-boil eggs; cool; halve; remove yolks.
Mash yolks with yogurt, mayo, Dijon, salt.
Pipe into whites; paprika, chives.

name: Roasted Chickpeas (Smoky)
steps: Pat chickpeas very dry.
Toss with oil, spices, salt.
Roast at 400°F 30–35 minutes, shaking twice; cool to crisp.

name: Cucumber Hummus Bites
steps: Slice cucumber into thick rounds.
Top each with hummus and a tomato half.
Sprinkle za'atar; drizzle oil.

name: Greek Yogurt Ranch Dip with Veggies
steps: Mix yogurt, ranch seasoning, lemon, chives.
Cut vegetables into sticks.
Serve together.

name: Turkey Roll-Ups with Avocado
steps: Spread turkey slices with cream cheese.
Add avocado and cucumber sticks.
Roll; sprinkle seasoning.

name: Cottage Cheese with Everything Seasoning & Tomatoes
steps: Spoon cottage cheese into a bowl.
Top with halved tomatoes.
Seasoning and oil.

name: Apple Slices with Almond Butter & Cinnamon
steps: Slice apple.
Spread or dip in almond butter.
Sprinkle cinnamon and hemp seeds.

name: Spicy Edamame
steps: Boil or steam edamame pods 4 minutes.
Toss with tamari, sesame oil, garlic, pepper flakes.
Sesame seeds.

name: Caprese Skewers
steps: Thread tomato, mozzarella, basil onto picks.
Drizzle balsamic and oil.
Serve.

name: Smoked Salmon Cucumber Rounds
steps: Slice cucumber into rounds.
Top with cream cheese and salmon.
Dill, capers, lemon zest.

name: Guacamole with Jicama Chips
steps: Mash avocado with lime, salt.
Fold in onion, cilantro, jalapeño, tomato.
Serve with jicama sticks.

name: Hard-Boiled Eggs with Everything Seasoning
steps: Boil eggs 9–10 minutes; cool in ice water.
Peel and halve.
Sprinkle seasoning; dash hot sauce.

name: Trail Mix (No Added Sugar)
steps: Combine nuts and seeds.
Add coconut and chopped dark chocolate.
Portion into 40 g servings.

name: Celery with Peanut Butter
steps: Cut celery into sticks.
Fill with peanut butter.
Sprinkle chia.

name: Baked Zucchini Chips with Parmesan
steps: Slice zucchini thin; blot dry.
Toss with oil, parmesan, seasonings.
Bake on racks at 400°F 25–30 minutes until crisp.

name: Shrimp Cocktail with Avocado
steps: Poach shrimp with Old Bay 3 minutes; chill.
Mix tomato paste, hot sauce, lemon, Dijon, a little water for cocktail sauce.
Serve shrimp with sauce and avocado slices.

name: Buffalo Cauliflower Bites
steps: Toss florets with oil and garlic powder; roast at 425°F 22 minutes.
Toss in hot sauce melted with butter; roast 6 minutes.
Serve with yogurt-blue cheese dip and celery.

name: Greek Yogurt with Berries & Chia
steps: Spoon yogurt into a bowl.
Top berries and chia.
Cinnamon.

name: Tuna Cucumber Boats
steps: Halve cucumber lengthwise; scoop seeds.
Mix tuna, yogurt, Dijon, celery, dill, lemon.
Fill boats.

name: Stuffed Mini Peppers with Herbed Goat Cheese
steps: Halve and seed mini peppers.
Mix goat cheese, yogurt, herbs, garlic, pepper.
Pipe into peppers.

name: Kale Chips
steps: Tear kale; dry thoroughly; massage with oil.
Sprinkle nutritional yeast, salt, paprika.
Bake at 300°F 12–15 minutes until crisp.

name: Cheese & Nut Snack Plate
steps: Slice cheese and cucumber.
Arrange with almonds, olives, pickle.
Serve.

name: Chocolate Peanut Butter Protein Balls
steps: Mix all ingredients into a stiff dough, adding almond milk as needed.
Roll into 16 balls.
Chill 30 minutes; store refrigerated up to 1 week.

name: Cinnamon Roasted Almonds
steps: Whisk egg white with vanilla; toss almonds to coat.
Toss with cinnamon, sweetener, salt.
Bake at 325°F 15 minutes; cool.

name: Egg Salad Cucumber Cups
steps: Hard-boil and chop eggs; mix with yogurt, Dijon, chives, salt.
Cut cucumber into thick rounds; scoop centers.
Fill; paprika.

name: Prosciutto-Wrapped Asparagus
steps: Wrap 2–3 spears in half a prosciutto slice.
Brush with oil; roast at 425°F 10–12 minutes.
Parmesan, pepper.

name: Spinach Artichoke Dip (Yogurt) with Veggies
steps: Wilt spinach; squeeze dry; chop artichokes.
Mix with yogurt, cream cheese, half the cheeses, garlic, salt; top remaining cheese.
Bake at 375°F 18 minutes; serve with vegetable dippers.

name: Avocado Deviled Eggs
steps: Hard-boil eggs; halve; remove yolks.
Mash yolks with avocado, lime, cilantro, jalapeño, salt.
Fill whites; paprika.

name: Nori Wraps with Tuna & Avocado
steps: Mix tuna with mayo and sriracha.
Lay on nori with avocado and cucumber.
Roll; slice; sesame.

name: Roasted Pumpkin Seeds with Chili Lime
steps: Toss seeds with oil, chili powder, lime zest, salt.
Roast at 325°F 15 minutes, stirring once.
Cool.

name: Turkey & Cheese Lettuce Roll
steps: Layer turkey and cheese on romaine leaves.
Add Dijon and tomato.
Roll and eat.

name: Ricotta & Berry Bowl
steps: Whisk ricotta with vanilla and stevia.
Top raspberries.
Almonds.

name: Baba Ganoush with Vegetable Dippers
steps: Roast whole eggplants at 425°F 40 minutes; cool; scoop flesh.
Blend with tahini, lemon, garlic, half the oil, cumin, salt.
Drizzle oil, parsley; serve with vegetables.

name: Mozzarella & Tomato Bites with Pesto
steps: Halve tomatoes; cube mozzarella.
Toss with pesto.
Basil.

name: Cottage Cheese Stuffed Cherry Tomatoes
steps: Slice tops off tomatoes; scoop seeds.
Mix cottage cheese with herbs and pepper.
Fill tomatoes.

name: Seaweed Snack & Edamame Plate
steps: Steam edamame 4 minutes.
Plate with roasted seaweed.
Tamari, sesame.

name: Pizza Cucumber Bites
steps: Slice cucumber into rounds.
Top with marinara, mozzarella, olives, seasoning.
Broil 2–3 minutes.

name: Almond Flour Crackers with Cheese
steps: Mix almond flour, egg, parmesan, rosemary, salt into a dough; roll thin between parchment.
Cut into squares; bake at 350°F 12–15 minutes.
Serve with cheddar slices.

name: Peanut Butter Yogurt Dip with Apple
steps: Whisk yogurt, peanut butter, cinnamon, vanilla.
Slice apple.
Dip.

name: Salmon Salad Romaine Boats
steps: Mix salmon, yogurt, dill, lemon, celery, capers.
Spoon into romaine leaves.
Serve.

name: Baked Parmesan Crisps
steps: Spoon tablespoon mounds of parmesan on parchment.
Sprinkle pepper and seasoning.
Bake at 400°F 5–6 minutes until golden; cool to crisp.
